Title: Azure Spring Cloud is now generally available

Body.Content:
Azure Spring Cloud is now generally available and is fully supported with a 99.9% SLA (Standard Tier only). Use Azure Spring Cloud to bring modern microservice patterns to Spring Boot apps, eliminating boilerplate code to quickly develop robust Java apps. Easily deploy, operate, and scale your apps in a fully managed environment.

  • Distributed tracing with Application Insights enables you to easily identify issues in applications, troubleshoot, and take corrective actions.
  • Managed virtual network (in preview) allows you to control inbound and outbound network communications and allows Azure Spring Cloud to interact with on-premises systems or Azure services in virtual networks.
  • Autoscale (in preview) enables you to be more productive and cost-efficient by automatically scaling apps up or down based on load or schedule. Once autoscale is enabled, you can be rest assured that the service will take care of your underlying infrastructure and the load on your apps.

Learn more in our announcement blog and try Azure Spring Cloud today.
